headline: A globe built for exploring live layers.
linkedin:
I started God's Eye View to explore live spatial data on an interactive 3D globe inside the browser. The goal was to render open-source data layers directly across a single spherical view.

Because certain layers rely on third-party API access and uptime, those feeds are subject to the availability of external endpoints. The repository is completely open source if you want to look over how it is built.

Code: https://github.com/sourav-bwn/gods-eye-view
